data.title: Shaun Maleki gave Lulu and Georgia 1 star. Check out the full review...
data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

Apr 22, 2026

## [Everything was terrible](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/69e852000bdd42a386a29cc9)
Everything was terrible, from the beginning to shop to delivery the quality awful to return and get refund, purchased 4 items, came all separately in just the plastic bag, the quality not worth it spending $90, $110 for cushion !!! I mean terrible, sending it back had to packed them separately paying $27 for boxing and packaging, already emailed them told them everything was awful and ask them to cover my $26, no response

March 30, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Apr 22, 2026

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We’re very sorry to hear about your experience with the ordering, delivery, and return process, as well as your concerns regarding the product quality. We understand how frustrating this must have been.

We can confirm that this order was previously reviewed and resolved by our Customer Experience team.

We appreciate you bringing this to our attention, as feedback like this is shared internally to help us continue improving.
